thread:
maria: Heads-up — my shift ends in 15m and there's an open page for intermittent inference latency on prod. Still in triage but want to handoff context and make sure routing + escalation is clear. Short summary: spikes in tail latency starting ~07:12 UTC, affects model v2 on region us-west-2. Error rates are low (2%), but p99 latency > 3s for some requests.

jonathan: Thanks, Maria. Is this isolated to the runtime (model serving) pods or is there a node/host-level signal?

maria: Initial checks: runtime logs show repeated KV cache misses leading to longer decode times. No obvious OOMs or node reboots. infra metrics (node CPU/mem) look fine for the cluster. I ran the quick `rt-diagnose` and attached logs.

olga: @maria can you paste the incident-bot summary? want the exact page payload to confirm routing.

aya (incident-bot): Incident created: INC-2026-04-23-7189
Severity: P2 (user-visible latency)
Pages: runtime-oncall@redwood (primary), infra-oncall@redwood (secondary)
Affected customers: subset of hosted API (us-west-2), approx 6 tenants with elevated p99
Mitigation suggestions: enable prefix KV caching, fallback to model-v1-small, run canary route split.

samir: Customer comms note: Support has 2 open tickets referencing slow responses; customers are circumspect but not yet escalated. We should avoid broad “service degraded” notices until we can confirm root cause or mitigation.

lee: Quick security check: any anomalous auth or traffic pattern? If it's just cache misses and normal traffic profiles, security likely doesn't need to page. But if anyone sees repeated 401/403 spikes or token errors, tag me and I'll jump in.

maria: No auth anomalies. Traffic QPS is steady; latency correlates with specific request shapes (long context lengths). Looks like runtime path under high KV miss rate degrades heavier requests.

jonathan: Ok that aligns. Routing question for on-call: when runtime sees increased latency due to model internals (cache/memory/algorithmic), runtime-oncall owns mitigation (prefix caching, fallback model). If there is cluster-level resource pressure or network issues, infra-oncall should own. Security only pages if auth/anomaly. Support handles customer comms. We should update the runbook section to make that explicit.

maria: I'm adding that to the runbook now: runbook link: <https://internal.redwood/runbooks/inference-paging>. Key snippet I added:
```
Ownership matrix:
- runtime-oncall: inference algorithm, model variants, KV cache, prefix cache, traffic routing
- infra-oncall: nodes, autoscaling, network, k8s control plane, persistent disk errors
- security-oncall: auth/token anomalies, suspicious traffic patterns, data-exfiltration alerts
- support: customer notifications and impact assessments
```

olga: Good. Also note current coverage gap: our infra-oncall is on PTO until 14:00 UTC and there is no backup listed for that window. We should pick a secondary now in case we need infra ops during next 2h.

samir: I can be secondary for infra for the next 90m if needed (I know the basic `kubectl rollout` steps and will loop Jonathan on exec). Will step out if something more complex is required.

jonathan: Appreciate that. Maria, for handoff I need the exact commands you ran and the path to logs. Also, if you can mark the tenants affected so support knows scope.

maria: Pasted commands below:
```
rt-diagnose --cluster us-west-2 --since 15m > /tmp/rt-dump.log
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/runtime-v2 -c runtime --tail=200 | grep "kv-miss"
# toggle prefix cache (safe): curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/reconfig" -d '{"prefix_cache":true}' --header 'Content-Type: application/json'
# quick rollback to model-v1-small: rr-route set default --model model-v1-small --weight 100 --reason "latency mitigation"
```
Affected tenant IDs (anonymized): tenant-117, tenant-220, tenant-331, tenant-947, tenant-2

aya (incident-bot): Reminder: current oncall roster:
- runtime-oncall: maria (primary), jonathan (secondary)
- infra-oncall: jonathan (primary), (no secondary assigned)
- security-oncall: lee (primary)

maria: Handoff plan (I'm handing to jonathan): I will stay on until 07:27 UTC to confirm prefix cache enable shows improvement. If p99 doesn't drop within 5m after cache toggle, I will execute the route rollback to v1-small and add a 10% canary first, then 100% if stable.

jonathan: Got it. If you do the 10% canary, ping #eng-runtime-api so infra can watch node-level metrics. If we need to scale nodes or adjust autoscaler thresholds, I'll take over infra ops. For now, I'll be primary after 07:27.

olga: Note for next runbook edit: include explicit steps for temporary canary split and a checklist of metrics to monitor (p50/p95/p99, error-rate, cpu, memory, network IO). Also add a clear 'when to notify customers' threshold (e.g., >5 customers impacted or p99>3s system-wide).

samir: I'll prepare a short customer-facing blurb ready to send if we need it. Keep me posted when you do canary.

maria: Update: prefix cache toggled at 07:20 UTC; p99 dropped from 3.4s to 1.3s for sampled tenants. Leaving monitoring on for 10m, will escalate to canary rollback if any regression.

aya (incident-bot): Event log: prefix-cache-toggle by maria at 07:20 UTC — metric delta observed.

lee: Thanks for the quick mitigation. Security still offline on anomalies. If anything changes, tag me.

jonathan: I'll stand by. If p99 climbs back above 2.5s across >3 tenants, I'll trigger infra escalation and consider temporary scale-up: `scale deploy/runtime-v2 --replicas=+3` and check autoscaler logs.

maria: All clear so far. Handoff: Maria -> Jonathan at 07:27 UTC. Primary: jonathan, Secondary: samir (infra backup). If infra requires deeper intervention, page olga and escalation path in runbook applies.

olga: Marking coverage change in calendar. Also filing a short post-incident note for next standup so we can update routing docs.

samir: Copy. I'll be available for the next 90m as infra backup and will monitor support tickets.

maria: Ok handing off now. tag me if things blow up in the next 15m; otherwise I'll log postmortem notes tomorrow. :thumbsup: :ambulance:

jonathan: Taking over. Thanks Maria. I'll keep this thread updated with any infra actions. :eyes:
